opening: Hi, remember the game I made you before? Well here’s a much more polished version of it featuring our time together. Maybe it would help you refresh your memory. 7 months has been a while since we last saw each other.
middle: These are our memories together and nothing can change that. It may have been a while but this happened we had a blast with each other. While I want that to happen more frequently I only want that with you. To dine out with you, go to random cafes and just sit, visit fun bars and try some drinks and just chill at home with you.
ending: Looking forward to our next adventure together! I love you best, Cody
letter: The past 3 months have been a rollercoaster. Maybe it was a wake-up call between us. When I saw photos of us when we started I had a lot of screenshots and photos of you even online. But after leaving the US in March I haven’t had any.

I’m sorry for the additional emotional rollercoaster I have put you through last week. I hope you can consider my proposal from yesterday. I know I can’t give you the dates you seemingly want right now. But I’ll give you the best ones when you’re back and when I go back to the US. We can also have dates online as well! You know I only make promises that I keep while I can’t promise a great time all the time. I promise to never put you in this position to decide again. I promise to take care of you and spend time with you. I promise that you will have a blast again just like these memories and more. I love you.
